selected_architecture.selection_reason: Highest feasibility-adjusted route with lower entry adverse-selection risk than first-breakout chasing while preserving a causal continuation edge and a holding horizon large enough to clear stressed BingX costs.
selected_architecture.causal_edge: A directional regime that survives a controlled pullback and then reclaims a pre-entry reference level can indicate continuation after temporary liquidity-taking rather than entry at the most adverse point of the initial impulse.
selected_architecture.failure_mechanism: The edge should disappear in weak/non-directional regimes, deep structural reversals, low expected-range conditions, event-gap conditions, or when all-in execution cost consumes too much of the planned move.

regime: 15m directional slope/structure computed only from closed bars
setup: pullback depth relative to pre-entry impulse or ATR
reclaim close above a frozen pre-entry reference for long; mirrored separately for short
volume/range confirmation only if independently available and pre-registered
cost_and_execution: expected gross move to stressed all-in cost ratio
spread/slippage floor from accepted BingX calibration receipt
funding horizon aligned to expected holding duration

order_lifecycle.entry_timing: next eligible bar after reclaim confirmation
order_lifecycle.stop: pre-entry structural invalidation or ATR-bounded stop, selected only in W1 from frozen bounds
order_lifecycle.target: fixed-R or structure target from frozen bounds
order_lifecycle.breakeven: disabled in generation 1 unless tested later as a distinct causal exit axis
order_lifecycle.partial_trailing: disabled in generation 1; standalone later only after base edge is positive
order_lifecycle.simultaneous_signal_policy: one position per symbol and one owner; no stacking, DCA or martingale

risk_and_sizing.leverage_assumption: not used to manufacture edge; report exposure separately
risk_and_sizing.loss_cap: one structural stop per trade; no widening after entry
risk_and_sizing.daily_stop: research metric only; runtime authority remains blocked

all_in_cost_contract.entry_cost_margin_rule: candidate expected gross move must exceed all-in cost by a frozen W1-selected multiple

bounded_generation_1_search.design_principle: coarse bounded search only; no inherited scalp_snap thresholds
bounded_generation_1_search.search_reduction_rule: Use a deterministic fractional/coarse design capped at 48 configurations; do not enumerate the Cartesian product.
bounded_generation_1_search.W1_selection_objective: maximize positive Net R/day subject to Net R>0, PF>=1, expectancy>0, payoff>=1, minimum sample and no hard-gate violation
bounded_generation_1_search.W2_W3_policy: freeze the exact selected configuration and source SHA; no retuning

data_split_contract.research_design_data: separate from W1/W2/W3 and final event stress
data_split_contract.event_corpus: independent stress only after candidate freeze under PR 586 contract

economic_fail_if: no W1 configuration has Net R>0, PF>=1, expectancy>0 and payoff>=1 with sufficient sample
selected W1 configuration is non-positive in either W2 or W3
2x-cost or plus-one-bar stress removes positive expectancy
positive economics depend on one symbol, one short interval, or one regime beyond concentration limits
retention/sample falls below the frozen minimum
independent recomputation or A/B parity fails

rejected_alternatives.reason: High score but first-impulse chasing has higher adverse-selection and slippage-tail risk; retained as a future independent family, not combined into generation 1.
Historical event-time L2/trade/queue/fill evidence is not proven available.
Cannot validate queue position, cancel latency, partial fills and inventory/adverse-selection risk with the current bar corpus.
Secondary route with larger liquidation-cascade tail risk; defer until the continuation family is independently resolved.
Conflicts with BingX-only active exchange policy and requires synchronized dual-leg execution.
Router is prohibited until at least two standalone positive families exist.

receipt_sha_policy: SHA256 over canonical JSON bytes must be emitted by the validator before any economic replay.
